jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Vacature kenmerken

Standplaats: Amersfoort

Contractduur: Tijdelijke aanstelling met uitzicht op vast.

Uren per week: - 38

Maandsalaris: €5.184,00 - €7.114,00

Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 11 - Burgerschaal IBBAD 11

Niveau: HBO Bachelor; WO Bachelor

Vakgebied: ICT

Vacaturenummer: 80808

Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling

Functiegroep: Burger

Dit ga je doen

Werken bij het ministerie Defensie, maar niet als militair?

Word Software Engineer

Als je kiest voor een baan bij Defensie, dan kies je voor maatschappelijk relevant werk. Je draagt echt iets bij aan een veilig Nederland.

Naast 48.000 beroepsmilitairen werken er ook nog zo’n 21.000 burgers bij Defensie. Ben jij een ervaren software engineer met een passie voor complexe technische uitdagingen? Wil jij bouwen aan de toekomst van gedistribueerde systemen voor Situation rooms, commandocentra en militaire voertuigen?

Als Software engineer ga je onze teams versterken bij het ontwikkelen van dit soort bijzondere software.

Hoogwaardige software vraagt om vaardige softwareontwikkelaars. Als medior ontwikkelaar bij JIVC/Landgebonden IT versterk je het team ‘Externe Koppelingen’. Jij bent de kritieke schakel tussen onze defensiesystemen en internationale partners. Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt de interfaces die veilig en naadloze informatie-uitwisseling mogelijk maken met onze coalitiepartners binnen de NAVO.

Je vertaalt complexe NAVO-standaarden en protocollen naar robuuste software die faaltolerant is. In een Agile omgeving, aangestuurd volgens SAFe, werk je samen met een multidisciplinaire team om interoperabiliteit te garanderen. Een of twee keer per jaar neem je je werk mee naar het veld om de connectiviteit live te valideren samen met coalitiepartners in live scenario's onder realistische omstandigheden. Jouw rol heeft een directe impact op internationale samenwerking en veiligheid.

Dit vragen wij

Je hebt een afgeronde technische HBO of WO-opleiding (bij voorkeur Informatica of Informatietechnologie) of kan aantonen op dit niveau te kunnen werken.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring als software engineer met Windows, C# en .Net of ervaring met Linux, C++ evt. in embedded systems.
Ruime ervaring in het participeren in multidisciplinaire ICT-projecten
Je hebt affiniteit met de automatisering van complexe operationele informatiesystemen.
Affiniteit en ervaring met communicatieprotocollen, multithreading en schalingsvraagstukken is zeer wenselijk.
Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden, je kunt overtuigen en neemt initiatief.
Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal in woord en geschrift.
Je hebt een Nederlandse nationaliteit of een gecombineerde vergunning voor verblijf en arbeid (GVVA). Dit is een vergunning die vreemdelingen van buiten de EU, Liechtenstein, Noorwegen, IJsland en Zwitserland het recht geeft om in Nederland te verblijven en te werken voor een periode langer dan drie maanden. Een vergunning is niet nodig voor werknemers uit landen van de Europese Economische Ruimte (EER) en uit Zwitserland. Voor deze landen geldt een vrij verkeer van werknemers.

Wie ben jij:

Je bent analytisch sterk;
Je neemt graag het initiatief;
Je hebt goede communicatieve vaardigheden en je kan goed in een team werken;
Je bent zelfstandig, kritisch en resultaat gedreven;
Je bent kwaliteitsbewust en stelt kwaliteit boven kwantiteit;
Je hebt integriteit hoog in het vaandel staan.

Dit krijg je

Salarisniveau: Burgerschaal IBBAD 11 - Burgerschaal IBBAD 11

Salarisomschrijving: Het genoemde salaris is gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek van 38 uur. Je inschaling wordt gebaseerd op je werkervaring en opleidingsachtergrond.

Maandsalaris: €5.184,00 - €7.114,00

Dienstverband: Tijdelijke aanstelling met zicht op vaste aanstelling

Contractduur: Tijdelijke aanstelling met uitzicht op vast.

Maximaal aantal uren per week: 38

Dit bieden we nog meer

Defensie hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en kent goede studiefaciliteiten, hierdoor sta je nooit stil. Je krijgt alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien.
Bij Defensie bouw je elke maand 16,33% van het bruto salaris op in het Individueel Keuzebudget. Je kunt het gebruiken voor het kopen van extra verlofuren of voor fiscale doeleinden.
Naast een pensioenregeling bij het ABP ontvang je maandelijks een tegemoetkoming voor woon-werkverkeer of kun je onder gunstige voorwaarden kiezen voor een OV-abonnement met onbeperkt reizen door heel Nederland.

Bijzonderheden

Deze vacature is zowel in- als extern opengesteld. Bij geschiktheid hebben interne kandidaten de voorkeur.
Een veiligheidsonderzoek maakt deel uit van de selectieprocedure.
Een referentiecheck en assessment kunnen onderdeel uitmaken van de selectieprocedure.
Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze functie moet je afkomstig zijn uit een land uit de Europese Economische Ruimte. Mocht dit niet het geval zijn dan beschik je over een gecombineerde vergunning voor verblijf en arbeid (GVVA).
Acquisitie wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Wij verzoeken vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde aanbiedingen, telefoontjes of e-mails te sturen. Dank u voor uw begrip.

Meer over de functiegroep

Organisatienaam

Ministerie van Defensie

Organisatieomschrijving

Defensie zet zich in voor de belangen, welvaart en vrijheid van Nederland. We zijn dagelijks actief in binnen- en buitenland. Onze wereldwijde inzet versterkt de internationale samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat mensen zich in vrijheid kunnen ontplooien. Nu en in de toekomst.

Bij het ministerie van Defensie werken ongeveer 79 duizend mensen direct en indirect aan vrede en veiligheid. Het ministerie bestaat uit het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT), de Bestuursstaf (het departement), de Koninklijke Marine, de Koninklijke Landmacht, de Koninklijke Luchtmacht, de Koninklijke Marechaussee, het Defensie Ondersteuningscommando (DOSCO).

Defensie is een van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland en vertoont overeenkomsten met een groot bedrijf. De operationele commando's (zee-, land- en luchtstrijdkrachten), de Marechaussee, het DOSCO en de COMMIT lijken op werkmaatschappijen.

Organisatie-URL

www.defensie.nl/organisatie/commit

Afdelingsnaam

Commando Materieel en IT

Afdelingsomschrijving

Standplaats: Bernhardkazerne te Amersfoort

Onder de vlag van JIVC, de IT organisatie van defensie, als onderdeel van het Commando Materieel en IT (COMMIT), ga je werken bij de afdeling Landgebonden IT/sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie (SO&I).

COMMIT zet zich in om collega’s in binnen- en buitenland het best mogelijke te bieden: het beste materieel, de beste voorraden en de beste ICT. Zo kunnen zij hun werk zo krachtig en effectief mogelijk doen.

De afdeling Landgebonden IT draagt op basis van diepgaande kennis van operationele gebruikers- en instandhoudingsprocessen, bij aan de vertaling van eisen en wensen naar concrete specificaties, hetzij t.b.v. een eigen software-ontwikkeltraject dan wel t.b.v. een extern aan te besteden ontwikkelopdracht. Landgebonden IT voert daarnaast het systeemmanagement over alle in stand te houden systemen, trainers en simulatoren. Landgebonden IT levert tevens (ook on site) support op de door de afdeling geleverde systemen en levert technische assistentie bij de implementatie en vervanging van deze systemen.

De sectie Systeemontwikkeling en Integratie is verantwoordelijk voor het integreren van extern verworven en/of intern ontwikkelde systemen en het zelf ontwikkelen en onderhouden van systemen.

Visie

Het Commando Materieel & IT (COMMIT) ondersteunt de transitie naar een informatie gestuurde en technologisch hoogwaardige krijgsmacht met het beste materieel en de beste IT. Ons COMMITment is groot om de cruciale rol te versterken als strategisch partner van de Commandant der Strijdkrachten, van de operationele onderdelen en van internationale partners. COMMIT vergroot de impact van de ondersteuning door een integrale en innovatieve aanpak van materieel- en IT-projecten, (wapen)systeemmanagement en ketenlogistiek.

Wij investeren in de kwaliteit van onze mensen en de flexibiliteit en diversiteit van het personeelsbestand. De belangrijkste capaciteiten van COMMIT zijn de kennis en ervaring van ons personeel. Om de krijgsmacht sneller te voorzien van materieel en IT zetten wij naast technologische innovatie in op proces- en sociale innovatie op het gebied van projectvoering, inkoop en afstoting van defensiematerieel en personele en logistieke ondersteuning.

Het uitvoeren van innovatieve projecten vraagt om meer samenwerking met het bedrijfsleven, kennisinstituten en andere overheidsorganisaties en maatschappelijke instanties. Onder de vlag van C-COMMIT als National Armaments Director (NAD) ontwikkelen en versterken wij ook de internationale samenwerking op het gebied van materieel en IT (NAVO, EU, multinationaal en bilateraal).

Missie

COMMIT levert de krijgsmacht het beste materieel en de beste IT.

Extra

COMMIT is van iedereen en voor iedereen, we zijn ervan overtuigd dat we met een diverse en inclusieve organisatie onze taak, verbinding maken tussen willen en kunnen, het beste kunnen uitvoeren wanneer ons personeel een afspiegeling is van de maatschappij. Wij nodigen je daarom graag uit om te solliciteren op deze functie!

Afdeling-URL

www.defensie.nl/organisatie/COMMIT

jobs.title: Senior Controls & Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior / Principal Controls & Software Engineer | Eindhoven, Netherlands - fully employed (perm)

This is a senior, strategic role for an experienced engineer who can define scalable and compliant solutions while remaining close enough to the technology to guide implementation, integration and validation.

The role

You will lead the architecture, development and implementation of control systems, embedded software and manufacturing applications. You will act as a technical authority across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Supply Chain and external technology partners.

The role will focus on building reliable, secure and compliant systems that support manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer and future commercial growth.

Key responsibilities

Define and govern the long-term controls, automation and software architecture roadmap.
Lead the design and development of PLC, SCADA, HMI, embedded software and industrial control solutions.
Establish scalable, modular and standardised software and automation architectures.
Act as the technical authority for controls, automation, manufacturing software and systems integration.
Define technical standards, system requirements, design specifications and software development practices.
Lead software verification, validation and Computerised System Validation activities.
Ensure systems comply with GMP, GAMP5, data integrity and electronic-record requirements.
Support manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer and the transition from development into commercial production.
Drive integration across manufacturing systems, MES, data platforms, cloud services and business applications.
Develop approaches to advanced process control, digitalisation, analytics and Industry 4.0.
Set standards for system reliability, lifecycle management, maintenance and OT cybersecurity.
Lead complex troubleshooting, root-cause investigations and continuous-improvement initiatives.
Provide technical leadership, mentoring and guidance to multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Manage technical relationships with equipment suppliers, automation vendors and systems integrators.
Support project planning, risk assessment, commissioning and validation.

Skills and expertise required

Master’s degree or PhD in Automation, Control Systems, Software, Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
Significant experience in industrial automation, control systems and manufacturing software.
Strong experience with Siemens PLCs, Ignition SCADA, HMI systems and industrial control architectures.
Knowledge of PLC programming, debugging, industrial networks and system integration.
Practical experience leading automation projects from concept through implementation, commissioning and validation.
Strong understanding of CSV, software verification and validation, GMP, GAMP5 and data integrity.
Experience within a regulated manufacturing environment, such as medical devices, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology or a related sector.
Experience supporting manufacturing scale-up, technology transfer or process automation.
Knowledge of MES, historians, manufacturing data platforms and cloud or middleware integration.
Understanding of industrial cybersecurity, including IEC 62443 principles.
Experience defining technical standards and influencing engineering strategy across an organisation.
Experience managing automation vendors, equipment suppliers and systems integrators.

Leadership profile

The successful candidate will be:

A strategic thinker who can balance long-term architecture with practical delivery.
Confident acting as a technical authority and influencing stakeholders at all levels.
Comfortable translating complex technical issues for technical and non-technical audiences.
Highly analytical, organised and capable of managing multiple priorities.
Passionate about innovation, continuous improvement and engineering excellence.
An experienced mentor who can raise capability across engineering and manufacturing teams.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Windows Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
Who You’ll Work With

This role sits within EMEA Client Engineering and reports to the Manager, Client Engineering. The engineer collaborates with regional and global Windows, endpoint, infrastructure, security, cloud, retail technology, and operations teams to build dependable platforms and raise engineering standards across Nike.

Who We Are Looking For

Nike is looking for a versatile senior engineer with broad Windows platform knowledge, strong software engineering fundamentals, and the judgment to work beyond a single technical specialty. The candidate combines hands-on engineering depth with curiosity across automation, endpoint management, infrastructure, cloud services, virtual desktop technologies, and operational reliability. They write maintainable code, understand modern delivery practices, and use automation to replace repetitive manual work. Just as importantly, they lead through example: setting expectations for quality, documentation, testing, ownership, security, and collaboration. The right person is comfortable challenging established approaches constructively, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, and influencing technical direction without relying on formal authority. They enjoy sharing knowledge, reviewing the work of others, and helping a team become more consistent and effective. This role suits an engineer who wants room to shape their focus over time while remaining accountable for measurable business and technology outcomes.

Typically 7+ years of relevant experience in software, platform, endpoint, infrastructure, or systems engineering.
Strong Windows engineering experience, with working knowledge of endpoint management, identity, security, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
Demonstrated coding and automation capability using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Perl, or Java, together with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines.
Experience with modern virtual desktop platforms, cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code, observability, or enterprise-scale automation is strongly valued.

What You’ll Work On

You will engineer and modernize Windows platform services used across Nike, while helping the team establish consistent ways of working. You will combine software engineering, automation, technical leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to improve security, reliability, scalability, and the employee experience.

You will design, build, automate, and improve enterprise-scale Windows platform capabilities across endpoint, infrastructure, cloud, and virtual desktop environments.
You will develop maintainable tools, services, scripts, and automation using sound software engineering practices, version control, testing, and peer review.
You will build and improve CI/CD pipelines that enable secure, reliable, observable, and repeatable delivery.
You will set the standard for engineering quality, documentation, operational readiness, ownership, and continuous improvement within the team.
You will lead technical investigations, architecture discussions, proofs of concept, and modernization initiatives that address complex business and technology challenges.
You will partner with global and regional engineering, security, operations, retail technology, and product teams to turn shared requirements into scalable solutions.
You will mentor colleagues, share knowledge, provide constructive technical feedback, and shape your own area of focus as the organization and its priorities evolve.

Applications will be accepted until 7th October 2026. We encourage external candidates to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer, Billing Platform
jobs.description:
What You’re Applying For

We're looking for an Automation-First QA Engineer to help us build quality into the Billing Platform from the ground up. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, automation, and AI — and it's core to how our Engineering team ships fast without breaking things. You'll own quality strategy for your domain and shape the tools, frameworks, and systems that let developers and AI agents move at full speed.

We believe three things matter for every role at Lemonade: drive to push through challenges, efficiency that keeps standards high while moving fast, and adaptability that lets you pivot with data and AI insights. These aren't buzzwords, they're how we actually work.

Our AI-first approach isn't just a tagline either. We're building the future of insurance with AI at the center, and we need people who are genuinely excited to learn and grow alongside these tools.

In this role you'll

Own quality strategy for the Billing Platform — setting the vision while empowering developers to lead day-to-day quality in their code
Build and evolve automated testing solutions across Web, API, and end-to-end user flows
Design tools, frameworks, and infrastructure that make quality faster, more scalable, and more autonomous
Use AI agents and prompt engineering to improve test creation, coverage analysis, and other parts of the quality lifecycle
Partner with developers, Product, and Design to surface risks early and influence technical decisions before they become costly ones
Translate quality data and delivery signals into clear recommendations on gaps, priorities, and readiness
Drive quality engineering best practices across the organization — not just within your own domain

What You'll Need

4+ years of experience as a QA Engineer or Software Engineer in Test
Strong coding skills in at least one modern language — TypeScript, Python, or similar
Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or comparable modern automation frameworks
Experience designing end-to-end testing strategies across Web, API, and data layers
A builder mindset — you turn ideas into tools and frameworks, not just test cases
A red team instinct — you challenge assumptions, stress-test decisions, and find the edge cases others miss
Familiarity with AI tools, prompt engineering, or AI agents, and genuine curiosity about where they take software quality next
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Ready to work in an office environment most days of the week

Die WENZEL Group ist einer der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Messtechnik und Styling Solutions. Zum Produktportfolio gehören Koordinaten- und Verzahnungsmessgeräte, industrielle Computertomographen und optische High-Speed-Scanning-Systeme. WENZEL hat mittlerweile über 12.000 Messlösungen bei kleinen und mittelständischen Unternehmen sowie namhaften Großkonzernen auf der ganzen Welt installiert – überwiegend aus der Automobilbranche, dem Flugzeug- und Maschinenbau sowie der Kunststoff- und Medizintechnik. Niederlassungen und Vertretungen in mehr als 50 Ländern unterstützen den Verkauf und stellen den After Sales Service für unsere Kunden sicher.

Seit über 50 Jahren bietet die WENZEL Group ihren Mitarbeitern abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeitsfelder und sichere Arbeitsplätze. Wir sind stets auf der Suche nach neuen Talenten, die unseren Unternehmenserfolg aktiv mitgestalten.

C# / .NET Softwareentwickler/in (m/w/d)

Referenznummer GR130

Entwicklung von Desktop-Anwendungen auf Basis eines vorhandenen PRISM Frameworks in C# im Bereich der Koordinatenmesstechnik
Koordinatenmesstechnik, speziell Zahnradvermessung und -auswertung nach nationalen und internationalen Normen
Implementierung neuer Funktionalitäten und Code-Optimierung

jobs.description:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners.

Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin.

Part of something bigger

Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants.

Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe.

We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

Your Hiring Experience Matters

Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive.

If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.

📋 Your role as a (Senior) Engineering Manager

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll help to elevate your team's technical standards by championing sustainable development, prioritising operational excellence, and fostering a quality-first mindset. You’ll strike a balance between ambitious technical goals and pragmatic delivery, ensuring that reliability, security, and long-term scalability are integral, not secondary.

The Engineering Manager shall ensure that the team's purpose and accountability are tightly integrated with the organisation's strategic objectives, creating an environment where engineers can dedicate their focus to high-value work, consistently shipping value early and often.

Whether engaging with the team, collaborating across the organisation, or in broader professional interactions, you’ll focus on building mutual understanding, aligning individuals around a shared purpose, establishing trust, and enabling action with empathy.

In joining a newly formed team, you’ll be joining a dynamic environment in which ambiguity is not a hurdle, but an opportunity. You’ll have the confidence to navigate evolving priorities and shifting landscapes with a forward-looking perspective, and convert uncertainty into focused action, leveraging the energy of change to drive innovation.

📍 Job located in Berlin, Copenhagen,

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Delivery: Own outcomes and help the team deliver what matters.
People: Build and grow a strong, motivated team.
Technical Leadership: Guide technical decisions and be accountable for the implementation: you own technical outcomes, without centralising every technical decision personally.
Architecture & DevOps: Bring strong technical judgement on testing, observability, incident response readiness, and security/privacy/data compliance ownership and embrace “you build it, you run it.”
Agile: Help the team find the ways of working that work best for them.
Collaboration: Work closely with Product, Design, EMs and the Domain Engineer.
Customer Focus: Keep customer needs at the heart of decisions.
AI: Use AI in practical ways to improve how we build software.

Your First 6–12 Months

0-3 Months

Form the team and build relationships.
Define the mission, vision and roadmap with the trio.
Set up the team for successful delivery.
Establish the team's ways of working.
Start AI adoption within the team.

3-6 Months

Deliver the first building blocks of the global accounting kernel.
Establish a sustainable delivery rhythm.
Move towards AI-native engineering practices.

6-12 months

Continue delivering and evolving the accounting kernel to 9+ europeen countries.
Build a strong, high-performing team.
Further embed AI-native engineering practices.

Senior EM Focus Only

Support other teams and domains.
Contribute to the wider engineering organisation.
Help set up or accelerate AI adoption across R&D.

🔎 About you

You're an experienced Engineering Manager who combines strong delivery, people leadership and technical capability
. You're comfortable with ambiguity, change and making decisions without having all the answers.

Must-Have Experience

2+ years Engineering Management experience, ideally with experience in a second EM role.
Strong technical background and ability to challenge technical decisions.
Full SDLC and DevOps experience: testing, observability, incident response readiness, and security/privacy/data compliance ownership - "you build it, you run it."
Strong and production-proven opinions on architecture, design, testing and cloud (AWS preferred).
Strong Delivery Management experience: you own the roadmap, steer timeline conversations on metrics, drive forecasting, balance feature work against technical improvements, operations and maintenance.
Strong People Leadership experience: run structured 1:1s, manage the career development, have direct performance conversations, establish an inclusive environment with high psychological safety.
Comfortable with ambiguity and change.
Strong Agile mindset, with experience in Kanban or similar.
Customer-focused and able to connect technical work to customer problems.
Active engagement with AI beyond experimentation - you have proven experience in using AI inside of software engineering/R&D. Youcan critically evaluate their impact
Discovery experience working with Product and Design.

Specific programming language experience such as TypeScript, React or Node.js is not mandatory.

Nice to Have

TDD and/or BDD experience.
Accounting or FinTech background.

💚 Our recruitment process

1️⃣ Screening call with Talent Acquisition (45 mins):
An initial conversation covering your background, motivations, expectations, and an overview of the role.

2️⃣ Hiring Manager Interview (60 mins):
A deep dive into your leadership journey, people management approach, and delivery execution.

3️⃣ Technical Interview (60 mins):
A technical discussion focusing on your technical depth, engineering standards, and architectural experience.

4️⃣ Architecture & Delivery Case (75 mins):
A practical case study session evaluating system design, delivery management, and handling ambiguity in trade-off decisions.

5️⃣ Meet the Trio (30 mins):
A strategic alignment conversation with key leadership partners focusing on cross-functional collaboration.

6️⃣ Personality Assessment Feedback (30 mins):
A collaborative review of your workplace personality questionnaire to discuss communication preferences and working styles.

7️⃣ Meet the Team (30 mins):
An informal session with your future team members and peers to explore team cohesion, daily collaboration, and culture fit.

jobs.title: Engineering Compliance and CSV Manager
jobs.description:
Hi! We are AMBOSS, and we're looking for someone to take the role of Engineering Compliance Manager and CSV & Process Validation Manager
in our medical device team.

About AMBOSS

AMBOSS is a dynamic learning and clinical decision support tool committed to empowering physicians globally to deliver optimal care. Since our inception in 2012, we've harnessed cutting-edge technology to transform the way physicians acquire and apply scientific knowledge. Each AMBOSSian is passionate about being the champion of clinicians today - this motivates and unites us each day towards success. And what does success look like? When a clinician or med student tells us, “AMBOSS makes practicing medicine easier and enjoyable. I love what I do, and a big part is because of AMBOSS.”

Why can this position be exciting for you?

At AMBOSS, we build tools that help doctors and students make critical decisions impacting the healthcare of billions of people worldwide. This position makes sure that our product is built, verified, and documented in a way that's compliant, trustworthy, and audit-ready. You'll work closely with engineering as an independent evaluator, setting the standard for what "done and compliant" means across our medical device software. Join a small, high-impact team ensuring our medical device software meets the regulatory standards needed to safely support healthcare professionals.

You Will

As CSV & Process Validation Manager, prove our systems and processes work and produce reliable evidence.

Own the computer system validation and process validation processes for the AMBOSS medical device portfolio — procedures, templates and work instructions — keeping them aligned with MDR and ISO 13485 and updated based on audit findings and team feedback.
Maintain the inventory of systems in scope and decide, risk-based, which need validation and to what depth; plan, execute and document that validation and keep systems in a validated state as they change.
Concentrate validation effort where the evidence is produced — test management, defect tracking, build/release tooling and automated pipeline steps whose output can't be fully verified by inspection alone — confirming these systems and processes reliably produce trustworthy, intended results.
Own the resulting evidence and represent it directly to auditors and regulators; raise, document and own validation deviations and the associated CAPAs through to resolution.

As Engineering Compliance Manager, ensure the medical device product itself is built compliantly, from a day-to-day engineering work perspective

Own compliant execution of the software lifecycle — requirements, design, implementation, verification, release — against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1
Define the compliance requirements and gates in our delivery pipeline against IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 (traceability tagging, release criteria, automated checks) and partner with engineering to implement them.
Operate the compliance gate in the release flow, keeping the trace intact from user requirement through verification to released evidence. Sign off each release as a required gate; no release ships without your approval.
Ensure engineering-related Technical Documentation deliverables are compliant with regulatory and QMS requirements
Onboard and train software engineers on compliance requirements and how to work within them day-to-day.
Act as the point of contact for audits and technical reviews on engineering-related topics, representing the team's compliance posture to auditors and Notified Body reviewers.
Drive resolution of audit findings and deficiencies affecting engineering.
Assess the engineering impact of Design Changes before they are implemented.
Identify and drive adoption of tooling the team is missing to work compliantly — both inside the QMS and on the engineering side.

You Bring

Knowledge of medical devices or another regulated industry (pharma, biotech, IVD). Experience in, or eagerness to learn, computer system validation and/or process validation, including risk-based scoping of validation effort, is a plus.
Working knowledge of MDR, ISO 13485, IEC 62304 and IEC 82304-1 as they apply to software.
Familiarity with software engineering, and enough depth in our stack (React, Python, PHP, Go; AWS, Terraform, Kubernetes, ArgoCD) to review pipelines, tests and release processes with engineers as a peer.
Experience representing validation documentation and rationale to auditors and inspectors.
Experience assessing the engineering/technical impact of Design Changes within a regulated development process.
Excellent written and spoken English

You Enjoy

Working closely with engineers, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs — able to challenge and be challenged on technical detail.
Strong communication and training skills, with the ability to explain complex validation requirements to cross-functional stakeholders
Structured, detail-oriented way of working, with the ability to balance regulatory rigor with practical, workable processes for development teams

Benefits

AMBOSSians tell us that innovative work keeps them energized, and employee benefits help them to feel appreciated and empowered. We invest in every AMBOSSian with our employee benefits package, crafted to support financial, physical, and mental health and work-life harmony.

Check out all of our employee benefits here: https://go.amboss.com/the-amboss-prescription-de

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. That's why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyone — regardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity — is valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfill our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care.

Even if you don't meet every single point in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. We'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Test Automation Engineer to join our team of dedicated automation testers working on a wide variety of agile projects across Health, Retail and Finance sectors.
The Test Capability @ Answer are passionate about “shift left testing” , which ensures testers are involved from day 1, making sure TDD is in place to catch and fix issues early and make better quality solutions for our clients.
We're excited about using AI to accelerate and improve our work, while applying our expertise and judgement to ensure everything meets a high quality standard.
If you’re passionate about wanting to champion better testing (whether that’s new tools, technologies or ways of working) - we’d love to hear from you!

What you’ll bring to Answer:

Designing bespoke Test Strategies to compliment technical solutions implemented using cloud technologies (K8s, Docker).
Building frontend automation frameworks using the latest open source test automation tools (such as Cypress and Playwright)
Building backend automation frameworks using the latest open source test automation tools (HttpClient/RestSharp/RestAssured (C#), RestAssured (Java), SuperTest/Jest (JavaScript))
Working in an agile (Scrum/Kanban) project environment utilising a test first approach which drives and creates a shared understanding of project requirements e.g. Shift Left, Example Mapping, BDD, 3 Amigos
Implementation of automated quality checks to run as part of a continuous integration environment (GitHub/ Azure DevOps / AWS Pipelines)
You should also have an enthusiasm for leveraging new AI technologies to enhance your workflow and improve outcomes

It would be great if you also had experience in some of these, but if not we’ll help you with them:

Test Consultancy experience e.g. working on customer site and advising on agile test strategy and best practices
Mentoring of junior testers and contributing to our test community
Knowledge and experience of non-functional testing e.g. Performance Testing (Locust, k6, JMeter), Accessibility Testing (WCAG 2.2, AXE) or Security Testing (OWASP top 10/ Snyk/ Grype)
Experience of Data/ETL Testing
Experienced in AI usage in test, whether through AI enabled frameworks such as UIPath or Vibium or using coding focused LLMs like Claude Code or Github Copilot to accelerate your work.

The perks of being @ Answer

We’re an Employee-Owned Company. After 12 months – through the Employee Ownership Trust you will be part of the ownership of Answer; a major factor in driving engagement, retention and growth for our people
Competitive salary
Flexible annual leave (buy/sell and carry forward)
Twice a year income-tax free bonus based on company performance - it’s a reward for being a part of our EOT journey
Continuous training and development - if you want to learn, we’ll provide the support you need
Flexible Pension - we match your own contributions up to 5%
A flexible Healthcare cash plan so you can fund the care you value most
A packed social calendar including; end of year party (partners invited) and Summer away days, monthly and quarterly company team socials.
Parking at Head Offices in central Leeds, plus Cycle2Work & Green Car Lease schemes to help get you here
The chance to give back – get involved nationally and regionally with partnerships to get people from different backgrounds into tech, as well as lots of charity and community events
Hybrid and flexible working – you can vary your working when and where you work, to allow you to collaborate better, feed your creativity, and take the time and space to focus when you need to

Diversity and Inclusion

At Answer we proudly embrace diversity and inclusion - we want to create a safe environment for everyone to bring their true selves to work.
We will do everything we can to support your application. If you require any adjustments to be made to your application (whether that’s support with our interview questions, adjusting how we interview, or financial support with our hiring process) then please speak to Lesley Waghorn, Senior Talent Acquisition Consultant ( lesley.waghorn@answerdigital.com )

A bit more about us.

Answer Digital is a highly successful digital transformation consultancy headquartered in Leeds. We’re a company on a fast growth trajectory with a reputation of delivering large-scale, operational critical solutions.
People are at the heart of everything we do - so much so we’re owned by our people. It sets us apart from most digital businesses you’ll meet and defines our culture and values. Our people are invested in everything we do, because we are invested in them.
Don't believe us? Well check out our glassdoor and here what our people have to say

Our Interview Process

We pride ourselves on having a fair but flexible recruitment process, we want to create a platform where you can show us your best. For us, keeping it simple means you can focus on understanding if our people, values and the work we do are right for you. Our typical process can be broken down into 3 stages;
Recruiter call:
This normally lasts 15-30 minutes. We will talk to you about Answer Digital, the type of work we do, and an overview of the role. We’ll ask you some questions about your current situation and why you’re interested in working here. Here, we’d advise asking any “people” questions, anything about our culture, career progression or approach to flexible working.
Skills based interview:
This interview will be with 2 people, normally from the team you’re applying to work with. We can do this stage remote or in person, whichever you’d prefer. This interview will involve questions around your experience, the skills you’ve gained and the work you’ve done. We’ll also ask questions about the role and challenges you might face and how you’d face them. Here, we’d recommend asking questions about the role, the day to day responsibilities and what life in the team is like.
Cultural/Value interview:
This interview will be with 2 of our Leadership team, either our Directors or Capability Leads. It will focus on our culture and values, talking about our values and what they mean to us as well as understanding what values are important to you and how you like to work. This interview is about making sure Answer is right for you, as much as the other way around. Here, we advise you to ask as many questions around our business model, our ambitious growth plans and anything to do with Answer as a business.

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

Axon Fusus is a cloud-based Real-Time Crime Center (RTCC) platform developed by Axon to enhance public safety operations through integrated situational awareness. It consolidates live video, sensor data, and analytics from diverse sources including body-worn cameras, drones, fixed surveillance, and Automated License Plate Recognition into a unified interface accessible via command centers or mobile devices. The platform supports features like real-time location mapping of officers and resources, AI-driven alerts, and live video streaming which empower officers with timely intelligence. The platform is open and supports interoperability with a wide range of third-party technologies, while community engagement tools facilitate collaboration with residents and businesses to share camera feeds and tips. By providing a comprehensive, real-time view of unfolding situations, Axon Fusus aids in faster decision-making, and improved public safety outcomes.

As a senior engineer on the Axon Alerts team, you’ll be directly responsible for the design, development and delivery of the Axon Alerts platform. The platform ensures the right people are notified about the right information at the right time. You will be responsible for the system which ingests events from a range of 1P and 3P devices sources, the process of enriching with additional metadata, applying rules to determine recipients, and delivering alerts across a range of channels. You’ll also be responsible for the guidance and mentorship of the other engineers on the team. Operational excellence processes, metrics and dashboards are at the heart of our promise to keep our systems running 99.999%, even when bad days happen and the system unusually spikes.

This role is based out of our London office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

jobs.description:
An Introduction to Codal

Codal is an award-winning web design and development consultancy that helps enterprise organizations solve complex problems and accelerate growth through elegant, data-driven digital solutions. Our areas of expertise include application modernization, eCommerce, UX/UI design, product strategy, data analytics, and artificial intelligence.

At Codal, you will collaborate with some of the most innovative organizations in the world and work on cutting-edge technologies that push the boundaries of design and software development. We promote long-term success, not just for our clients but for our team, helping you develop a professional roadmap that takes your career to new heights.

Codal is looking for a Solutions Architect who can look at a client's technology landscape, understand what's working, what isn't, and chart a credible path forward. You'll design and defend end-to-end solutions across software, systems, data, AI, and DevOps, translating ambiguous business goals into architectures that are practical to build and easy to evolve.

This is a hands-on and client-facing role. You'll move between whiteboard sessions with client executives, deep technical design work, and hands-on prototyping to prove out an approach before committing a team to it. You're comfortable weighing cost, timeline, risk, and maintainability against each other, then making a recommendation and standing behind it.

We expect this role to embody Codal’s principles of mindful excellence, insatiable expertise, diverse intuition, data-led curiosity, and candid leadership in how you lead technically, mentor your team, and engage with clients.

Who You'll Be Working With

You'll work alongside client stakeholders, from engineering leads to executive sponsors, as well as Codal's project managers, designers, and delivery teams. You'll be involved from early discovery and pre-sales conversations through hands-on implementation and post-launch support.

Responsibilities

Assess a client's existing technology landscape (software, systems, data, and infrastructure) and rationalize the pros, cons, and risks of what's in place versus what's proposed.
Design end-to-end solution architectures spanning application, data, AI/ML, and DevOps concerns, and document them clearly enough for both engineers and executives to act on.
Present and defend architecture recommendations to client stakeholders, including technical leads and executive sponsors, with support from Codal's delivery and account teams.
Support discovery, technical planning, and pre-sales conversations, translating client goals and constraints into a scoped, deliverable technical approach.
Create and maintain architecture decision records that capture the trade-offs considered and the reasoning behind each major decision.
Guide engineering teams through implementation, staying hands-on where needed (prototyping, code review, unblocking hard technical problems) without holding up delivery.
Evaluate emerging tools, platforms, and AI capabilities, and bring forward recommendations that would meaningfully improve a client's solution or delivery speed.
Partner with DevOps, data, and engineering leads to align architecture with CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and data platform realities on the ground.
Mentor engineers and technical leads on architectural thinking, not just implementation, helping the broader team reason about systems, not just code.
Support planning, estimation, and risk management across the project lifecycle, flagging architectural risk early.

What You'll Need To Be Successful

9+ years of hands-on software or systems engineering experience, including experience designing and owning architecture for complex, client-facing solutions.
Understanding and ability to solve complex client problems that will impact client business.
Proven ability to evaluate an existing technology landscape and make a clear, defensible recommendation, including build-vs-buy and platform trade-offs.
Strong grounding across at least two of the following: application architecture, systems/infrastructure design, data architecture, AI/ML solutioning, and DevOps.
Comfort learning a new domain or stack quickly (just-in-time), with enough hands-on ability to validate an approach yourself rather than only directing others.
Experience presenting technical recommendations directly to clients, including non-technical and executive stakeholders.
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern CI/CD practices.
Solid understanding of databases and data platforms (SQL, NoSQL, and analytics platforms such as BigQuery).
Clear, confident communication skills, and the judgment to know when to hold a position and when to adapt it.
The drive to learn, adapt, and apply to the ever changing technology landscape.

Experience in a consulting or professional services environment, including supporting pre-sales, proposals, or client discovery.
Experience architecting solutions that incorporate AI/ML capabilities into existing products or platforms.
Experience leading architecture review boards or similar governance processes.
A track record of guiding teams through complex technical challenges and ambiguous requirements to a shipped outcome.
Certifications in a cloud platform or AI such as AWS Solution Architect or Claude Certified Architect

We’re forward-thinking by design, building for the AI-driven era rather than reacting to it.

The Role

Uniphar are embarking on an ambitious, multi-year transformation program and are seeking a Senior Solution Architect to own the architecture of Dynamics 365 Business Central, the ERP platform underpinning our Medtech division. Business Central is live and running the division's core finance, supply chain and distribution operations; this senior role holds accountability for the end-to-end technical design of the platform as it scales to support growth, new entities and acquisitions across multiple geographies. The ideal candidate combines deep, hands-on Business Central and AL extension expertise with the architectural judgement to design for resiliency, performance, integration and security in a regulated, medical device environment. This is a role for someone who is equally comfortable holding an implementation partner to account on a solution design, sitting with the business to uncover the next opportunity, and getting into the detail to make a change themselves. Working within an Agile, product-based delivery model, the Architect will set the technical direction, own the key design decisions, drive down technical debt, and lead a high-performing development team - ensuring we build the right things, in the right way.

Key Responsibilities

ERP Solution Architecture (Ownership)

Own the end-to-end architecture of Dynamics 365 Business Central as the ERP platform for Uniphar's Medtech division, from target state through to delivered design.
Define and maintain the target architecture, design principles and standards that govern how Business Central is configured, extended and integrated.
Act as the design authority for the ERP platform, making the key design decisions and reviewing and approving solution designs to ensure architectural integrity.
Own the technical debt agenda, moving the platform away from customisation-heavy patterns towards supportable, upgrade-safe design.
Balance business need, cost, time-to-value and long-term maintainability in every architectural decision.
Operate comfortably at both altitudes: setting enterprise-level direction one day and getting into the detail of a posting routine, page extension or permission set the next.

Vendor & Partner Design Assurance

Review, robustly challenge and approve solution designs produced by implementation partners, ISVs and third-party developers, rather than accepting them at face value.
Hold vendors to account on design quality, cost, effort estimates and supportability, ensuring proposed solutions are proportionate, upgrade-safe and genuinely fit for Uniphar's needs.
Ensure partner-delivered work meets Uniphar architecture, security, ALM and coding standards before it is accepted into the estate.
Build open, constructive relationships with partners while retaining design authority and architectural ownership in-house.

Business Partnering & Opportunity Identification

Get close to how the business actually operates, spending time with finance, supply chain, warehouse and commercial teams to understand their processes and pain points.
Proactively uncover opportunities where Business Central and the wider Microsoft stack can remove manual effort, reduce cost, improve control or unlock new capability.
Translate those opportunities into practical, well-sized proposals with a clear articulation of the value, effort and risk involved.
Challenge stated requirements to get to the underlying business need, and steer the business away from solutions that create long-term cost or complexity.

Core ERP Process Architecture

Own the solution design across the core ERP process areas: finance, purchasing, inventory and warehouse management, distribution and order-to-cash.
Ensure the design supports medical device distribution, including lot and serial traceability, expiry control, UDI and consignment / field inventory models.
Work with process owners to standardise ways of working across legal entities and geographies, minimising divergence and one-off design.
Design for master data integrity across items, customers, suppliers and the chart of accounts, and define how master data is governed across the estate.

Designing for Resiliency & Non-Functional Requirements

Design for resiliency, scalability, performance, availability and disaster recovery, ensuring non-functional requirements are captured and baked into every design.
Ensure the platform performs at scale under high transaction volumes across order capture, picking, invoicing and period-end processing.
Embed security, data protection and governance by design, implementing appropriate access controls, segregation of duties and governance policies across the platform.
Conduct architectural assessments of the existing solution and proactively drive improvements to performance, reliability and efficiency.
Own the approach to Microsoft's continuous release cycle, keeping the platform current and upgrade-ready with minimal disruption to the business.

Integration Architecture

Design robust, secure and scalable integrations between Business Central and the wider enterprise estate (e.g. Dynamics 365 CE, Azure, SAP, EDI, 3PL / warehouse systems, Microsoft 365 and third-party SaaS).
Select the right integration patterns and technologies (e.g. Azure Integration Services, Logic Apps, APIs, Dataverse) for each scenario.
Ensure integrations are resilient, observable and maintainable, with clear contracts, idempotency and robust error handling.
Define how transactional and master data flows to the group data platform to support reporting and analytics.

Quality, Compliance & Validation

Ensure the architecture supports the regulatory obligations of a medical device business, including data integrity, audit trail, traceability and data retention.
Design changes so they can be validated efficiently, working with Quality to ensure documentation, testing and change control meet GxP and medical device requirements.
Ensure the platform meets financial control requirements, including segregation of duties and full auditability of financial transactions.

Stakeholder Management

Engage senior stakeholders across the Medtech division and group functions (finance, supply chain, quality and technology) to understand needs and priorities and ensure the ERP architecture aligns to strategic outcomes.
Communicate architecture, options and trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Evangelise the art of the possible with Business Central and the Power Platform.

Key Skills, Experiences & Competencies

Deep, demonstrable experience architecting Dynamics 365 Business Central (or Dynamics NAV, with the upgrade path to Business Central) solutions at enterprise scale, ideally multi-entity and multi-country.
Strong functional grounding across the core ERP process areas: finance, purchasing, inventory and warehouse management, distribution and order-to-cash.
Comfortable working at every altitude, from enterprise architecture and design authority through to making straightforward configuration and code changes personally.
Hands-on AL extension development background (extensions, events / interfaces, custom APIs), underpinning credible, hands-on design leadership.
Sound judgement on when to configure, when to extend and when to buy, with a track record of keeping the core clean and upgrade-safe.
Strong knowledge of the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and sound judgement on where to apply low-code versus coded solutions.
Proven experience designing for resiliency, scalability, performance and disaster recovery (non-functional requirements), including high-volume transactional workloads.
Strong integration architecture experience across Azure (e.g. Logic Apps, Azure Integration Services, APIs); experience with EDI, 3PL / warehouse and SAP integration an advantage.
Experience with ALM / CI-CD and source control for Business Central (e.g. Azure DevOps, Git for Enterprise); manual deployment to test and production environments is not permitted.
In-depth understanding of security best practices, access controls, segregation of duties and governance for cloud and ERP environments.
Experience working in an Agile, product-based delivery environment, supporting a Product Owner and roadmap.
Proven experience managing, mentoring and leading developers and setting the technical quality bar for a high-performing team.
Ability to design innovative, re-usable solutions and components.
Proven ability to analyse complex technical issues and provide effective solutions.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to influence, challenge and build trust at all levels, internally and with third parties.
Experience in a regulated / GxP environment, ideally medical device or pharmaceutical distribution, including validation and change control.

Uniphar Background

Uniphar Group is a rapidly expanding diversified healthcare services business with a global footprint and a proud heritage in Ireland. Since Uniphar became a publicly listed company in 2019, the Group has grown organically and through a series of strategic acquisitions, which continue to strengthen Uniphar’s international reach. With a workforce of more than 3,000 spread across Ireland, United Kingdom, Mainland Europe, MENA and the USA, Uniphar is a trusted global partner to pharma and medtech manufacturers, working to improve patient access to medicines and treatments around the world.

Uniphar provides outsourced and specialised services to its clients, leveraging the strong relationships with 200+ of the world’s best known pharmaco-medical manufacturers across multiple geographies, enabled by our cutting-edge digital technology and our expert teams. Uniphar is organised into three key divisions: Uniphar Supply Chain & Retail, Uniphar Medtech and Uniphar Pharma

You will be part of a strong engineering environment, working with drilling-fluid products and the software and automation systems that control this equipment. You will join a close-knit team working together to deliver sophisticated automation solutions for drilling operations.

Work with automation technology used in some of the world’s most advanced drilling rigs.
Join a collaborative engineering team where knowledge sharing and teamwork are central to successful delivery.
Gain hands-on experience with real industrial automation projects and complex process systems.
Work across different engineering technologies rather than being limited to a single technical area.
Build experience in an international technology company while contributing to real customer projects.

Opportunities to develop expertise in PLC/HMI, software engineering, C++/C#, Qt, process automation, and system architecture.
Exposure to both project delivery and software development activities.
Opportunities to collaborate with different engineering disciplines and, when required, customers.
Increasing technical ownership and project delivery responsibility as your experience develops.
A supportive team environment focused on collaboration, continuous improvement, and professional development.

Program and support PLC and HMI/SCADA systems.
Translate drawings, schematics, and technical requirements into functioning automation solutions.

Prepare engineering and project documentation.
Contribute to software development and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with other engineers to meet project requirements and delivery schedules.

Experience with process automation, including PLC and/or HMI systems.
Solid understanding of software development principles and best practices, including design patterns and coding standards.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Norwegian and English.

Collaborative and open-minded approach, with a willingness to learn and contribute to the team.

jobs.description:
Location: On-site with possibility to work remote

Team: Data & AI

Seniority: Mid-Level to Senior

About The Platform

Our team is building the platform that captures, stores, and exposes the complete history of mission-critical OT (Operational Technology) asset access. Through event ingestion, audit logging, activity tracking, and data services, we provide the foundation for compliance and security reporting as well as AI-driven insights. Reliability, traceability, and data integrity are at the core of what we do.

About The Role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer with a strong hybrid skill set across C#/.NET and Python to help us build the services that turn our audit and activity data into insight. Your main mission is to design and build the event-driven pipelines and backend services that sit on top of the audit platform: processing events as they arrive, enriching them with context, detecting meaningful patterns, and delivering the result to the people and systems that need to act on it.

You will work closely with colleagues in the Data & AI team to take analytical work from proof of concept into production. That means the plumbing that makes intelligence useful: pipelines triggered by platform events and completing inside a tight SLA, structured outputs stored in a schema that can evolve, APIs that expose those outputs cleanly, and delivery into customer tooling such as SIEM and collaboration platforms. Our data workflows run on Azure Databricks and our services run on Azure, and you will own significant parts of how these two worlds fit together.

This is a hands-on engineering role at the intersection of event-driven backend development, data engineering, and production operations. You will influence architecture across processing pipelines, detection logic, and integration interfaces.

We are looking for a self-driven and curious engineer who thrives in a collaborative environment. You value a healthy feedback culture, are open and approachable, and enjoy working closely with colleagues, ideally from the office, to solve problems together. You are focused, eager to learn, and motivated to continuously improve both our processes and your own work. You are comfortable navigating external constraints and can design robust solutions within those boundaries. You maintain a practical balance in documenting your work: thorough enough to ensure clarity and knowledge-sharing, yet efficient enough to avoid unnecessary overhead.

Beyond all that, this role is a fantastic chance to grow professionally, personally, and as part of a team that genuinely enjoys building great things together and having fun along the way.

What You Will Do

Event Processing & Pipelines

Build event-driven pipelines in C# and Python that pick up audit events as they land, process them inside a time budget, and turn them into records the product and customer tooling can query
Design processing that is correct under real-world conditions: retries, out-of-order delivery, poison messages, backpressure, and at-least-once semantics
Decide how pipeline output is stored and versioned. Our audit data is append-only, so there is no going back and rewriting it. A schema decision here is closer to permanent than in most systems
Take analytical work that has been proven in a notebook and make it a service that runs unattended: scheduling, retries, throughput, cost, and the monitoring that catches it when it stops being accurate

Detection & Enrichment Services

Build the backend that separates the handful of events worth investigating from the thousands that are routine: aggregation across sessions, users and devices, time windows, behavioral baselines, and risk scoring
Keep the signal-to-noise ratio high enough that customers leave the feature switched on: deduplication, suppression, thresholding, and confidence scores that are honest about uncertainty
Design a rules layer that customers can configure, without every new detection requiring a release
Enrich raw events with the context that makes them actionable: severity, reasoning, and links back into the product

APIs & Integration

Design and build the C# APIs that carry this output to the three places it gets consumed: our own product UI, customer SIEM platforms, and downstream services
Build integrations that deliver notifications and structured evidence into customer tooling (SIEM platforms, collaboration tools, downstream services)
Design clean data contracts and event formats suitable for compliance, security, and analytics consumers
Ensure APIs are robust, performant, and scale with growing event volumes

Running What We Build

Operate the services you build: monitoring, alerting, tracing, and incident response across Azure, Databricks, and our messaging layer
Build the observability that tells us when output quality degrades, not just when a service is down
Maintain CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and safe deployment practices for the services you own

What You Bring

Required Qualifications

Solid experience with C#/.NET backend development
Working proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline work — you do not need to have been a Python-first engineer, but you should be productive in it
Strong experience with event-driven and asynchronous systems — queues, event buses, or message brokers — and a clear understanding of their failure modes
Experience designing and implementing ETL or data pipelines in a production environment
Experience designing and building APIs (REST, and ideally streaming or event-driven interfaces)
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (preferably Azure Databricks) and with working across a Python data stack and a C#/.NET production environment
Solid understanding of relational and/or distributed data stores, including schema design and evolution
Experience building multi-tenant systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement — authorization enforced in the data access path rather than bolted on at the edge
Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions)
Strong sense of code quality, testing, and maintainability

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

Platform and engineering breadth

Queuing technology (e.g., RabbitMQ)
Data streaming architectures (Kafka, Event Hubs, change data capture)
Kubernetes and container-based deployments (Docker, AKS)
Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Bicep, Terraform)
Workflow orchestration tools (Databricks Workflows, Airflow, Azure Data Factory)
Azure services (Functions, Container Apps, Data Lake, API Management, Monitor / Log Analytics)
Observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
Distributed systems failure modes and resilience patterns
Append-only / immutable data stores and time-series databases

Domain

Familiarity with SOC tooling and concepts (SIEM integration, log forwarding, security event formats such as CEF/LEEF)
Rules engines or customer-configurable detection logic
Exposure to OT, ICS, or other mission-critical / regulated environments
Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as NIS2, ISO 27001, or IEC 62443

Machine learning and data science

Working alongside data scientists or ML engineers to productionize models — packaging, serving, and versioning
MLOps practices: experiment tracking, model registries, evaluation pipelines, confidence calibration, and drift detection (MLflow or similar)
Databricks and PySpark, Delta Lake, or other lakehouse technologies
Practical exposure to anomaly detection, behavioral baselining, or statistical/ML approaches to event data
Applied use of LLMs in production systems — structured output, evaluation, and cost control

Why Join Us

You will be joining an ambitious and fast-growing team that is shaping how data and AI power our products. We move quickly, take ownership of what we build, and care about doing things well. This is a place where your work has visible impact, where your ideas are heard, and where you can grow alongside colleagues who genuinely enjoy solving hard problems together. If you want to be part of building something meaningful with a team that values curiosity, collaboration, and craftsmanship, you will feel at home here.

jobs.title: Senior .NET Developer (SMARTLINK IoT platform)
jobs.description:
Your role

Connectivity is KEY! And within Atlas Copco, it has become one of the fastest-growing strategic domains. A decade of investment has given us an industry-leading fleet of more than 300,000 connected machines and 100,000 users, whose data powers SMARTLINK and drives our sales, service and operational processes worldwide. Behind it sits our IoT platform: the cloud-agnostic, event-driven backbone that ingests device telemetry, holds the model of every connected asset, and serves the portal, the mobile apps and a growing number of internal consumers. We are expanding our platform team with a senior .NET developer who builds that backbone.

You build the platform itself, not the screens in front of it. Your working level is domain models, APIs, messages and data: what a service owns, what its contract promises, which events it publishes, and how its data is shaped so that it still answers the questions we will ask of it in three years. You work in an agile team of 14 people with developers, architects, test engineers and product owner, shaping design decisions rather than only implementing them.

The work here is engineering, not configuration. We build on . NET 10
and C#, with PostgreSQL
for domain data, Apache Kafka
for events, Redis
for caching and ClickHouse
for high-volume telemetry. Services are containerised and run on Kubernetes, brought up locally with .NET Aspire and tested against real dependencies with Testcontainers, shipped through Azure DevOps pipelines and instrumented with OpenTelemetry
.

We are building a new back-end, designed around domain-driven design rather than carried over from what came before. The interesting questions are still open: where the domain boundaries lie, what each service owns, which events carry the truth. You get to answer them, on a fleet that is already global and still growing.

In This Role, You Will

Design and build domain services: bounded contexts, aggregates and a language the business recognises, in cloud-native .NET services that own their own data.
Own your API contracts: design APIs that others build on, version them deliberately, and treat breaking a consumer as a decision rather than an accident.
Design events, not just messages: Avro schemas in a registry, schema evolution, idempotency and replay, and a clear answer for the message that cannot be processed.
Model data for the questions it will be asked: relational design in PostgreSQL where the structure is known, JSONB where it has to stay flexible, and query patterns that still hold when the fleet doubles.
Engineer for fleet scale: hundreds of thousands of devices reporting continuously, where an unbounded consumer or a missing index is not a slow page but an outage.
Make your services observable and operable: OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs, health checks, and alerts worth being woken up for.
Test your own work, with unit and integration tests next to the product code against containerised dependencies rather than mocks, alongside the test engineers who build our shared framework.
Shape the design upstream and raise the bar around you: turn requirements into a workable domain model during refinement, say so when something cannot be built cleanly, and lead through review and standards people actually follow.
Leverage AI in your daily work, and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

Several years of hands-on C# and .NET back-end development, at a level where you own a service end to end and design the APIs others build on: contracts, versioning, and the discipline of not breaking your consumers.
A working grasp of domain-driven design: bounded contexts and aggregates applied to a real domain rather than a textbook one.
Hands-on with PostgreSQL, including JSONB where the model has to stay flexible, and comfortable writing and reasoning about your own SQL.
Apache Kafka as architecture, not plumbing: producers and consumers, partitions and offsets, schemas and delivery guarantees, and the distributed reality around them - asynchronous processing, eventual consistency, retries and idempotency, and the ways they fail in practice.
Container-based, cloud-agnostic development: Kubernetes (AKS / EKS / OpenShift), with containers and pipelines as part of how you build, test and ship.
Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Agile / Scrum experience, the confidence to say in refinement that something cannot be built the way it is specified, and fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Designing a domain model or a service landscape from the ground up.
ClickHouse or another columnar time-series store for high-volume telemetry, and Redis at scale.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. de technische architectuur van webapplicaties ontwerpen en verder ontwikkelen;
behoeften analyseren en ontwikkelingen inschatten binnen een Agile/SCRUM-omgeving;
performante Drupal-websites, -applicaties en -formulieren ontwikkelen die afgestemd zijn op de behoeften van de gebruikers;

de kwaliteit, veiligheid, onderhoudbaarheid en interoperabiliteit van de ontwikkelde oplossingen garanderen;
bijdragen aan technische keuzes en aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de werkmethoden binnen het team.

Bachelor in informatica, toegepaste informatica, softwareontwikkeling of een aanverwant domein
